evals.name: hardcoded-hex-cleanup
evals.query: The donate banner uses #26635d and 18px padding directly. Clean it up.
expected_behavior: Replaces the literal values with existing semantic tokens from src/styles/tokens.css (not the --msa-* brand primitives).
Uses existing spacing tokens or proposes one; does not invent a parallel naming scheme.
Runs the quick grep checks from the skill on the changed files.

evals.name: board-editable-accent
evals.query: The board wants to change the accent color for Ramadan without calling a developer.
expected_behavior: Explains the accent is a single-sourced token that a validated admin setting could override on the html element.
Treats exposing it in the dashboard as a product decision and routes the change through planning-engineering-changes.
Requires contrast re-verification for every design (color-systems-contrast-intelligence).

evals.name: should-not-trigger-contrast-check
evals.query: Does the grey caption text on the prayer page pass WCAG contrast?
expected_behavior: Does not load design-token-architecture; color-systems-contrast-intelligence owns contrast checks.
